dedupe_keys.name: exploring the network structure of coupled green grey infrastructure to enhance urban pluvial flood resilience a scenario based approach focusing on centralized and decentralized structures

description: Exploring the Network Structure of Coupled Green-Grey Infrastructure to Enhance Urban Pluvial Flood Resilience: A Scenario-Based Approach Focusing on ‘Centralized’ and ‘Decentralized’ Structures is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Samuel Park (Seoul National University). Urban pluvial floods pose a significant risk to cities, as they occur when rainfall exceeds the carrying capacity of the urban drainage network. Coupled green-grey infrastructure has emerged as a sustainable solution for mitigating urban pluvial floods. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
